g_roast: Twenty six years with a sabre, ragazzi, and footwork this bad belongs at a wedding in Secondigliano.
Fourth at the Olympic trials, twice, and even the man in fifth moved better than you lot today.
g_fire_back: Touche, very nice, from the one who lunged at a boar and hit a tree. Distance, uaglio, distance.
Bello, a clean touch, I'll allow it. Enjoy it, it won't happen again.
g_pile_on: Worse than that, ragazzi, I watched their feet. Crossed, both of them, the whole fight, like a drunk at a festa.
Afterwards, the question was what they did wrong. Everything below the knee, uaglio, everything.
lines.g_peacemake: Basta, both of you, step back, en garde, breathe. You're both lunging and nobody's parrying. Start again, slower.
lines.g_take_side: Mi dispiace, but {name} has the touch on this one. The referee in me can't say otherwise.
lines.g_left_out: Go on, you two, I'll practise my footwork over here. It's better company, and it doesn't argue.
lines.g_include: Jamme, sit down, there's room. Nobody stands alone at the edge of the piste.
lines.g_bad_plan: Strategy, ragazzi, very Neapolitan. We all lunge at once, no guard, no footwork, and hope they're slower than us.
lines.g_plan_yes: Bello, distance and timing, I'm in for that one.
lines.g_plan_no: Where's the guard in that plan? It's all attack. One riposte and we're finished, fix it first.
lines.g_hype: En garde, ragazzi, watch your feet, not their blades. Distance, timing, the touch, and we walk out of here.
lines.g_toast: A toast, quick, like a good attack. To all of you, the worst fencers I've ever trained, and the best company. Salute, all of you.
lines.g_cheers: Salute, ragazzi, and somebody find me an espresso, I'm dying.
g_quiet_line: Mergellina at sunset, ragazzi, the sea all gold, Vesuvius in the distance, and a pizza fritta in my hand. I'd fight anybody for one more of those.
Napoli on a Sunday, the whole city shouting at the radio. I'd give my sabre to hear that noise again.
lines.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, ragazzi, check your feet first. All breathing, good. A lost bout, that's all, and we fence again.
lines.g_crew: I fenced alone for twenty six years, ragazzi, one man on a piste. You're the first team I've ever had, and I like it, which surprises me.
lines.g_exasperated: I said watch the feet, three times, with demonstrations. And you watched the sword, every single one of you, mannaggia.
lines.g_love_sharp: You read the opening before it opens, {name}. That's a fencer's eye, and you didn't even train for it.
lines.g_love_kind: You help the beginners without making them feel small, {name}. I try to do that on Saturdays, and you just do it.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh mid bout, {name}, and I hate losing focus. For you I'll make an exception.
lines.g_love_brave: You close the distance when everybody else steps back, {name}. Bello, that's real courage.
lines.g_love_steady: Your guard never drops, {name}, whatever's coming. I'd stand next to you on any piste.
lines.g_love_clever: You see three moves ahead, {name}, a fencer's mind. Annoying, and very impressive.
lines.g_love_honest: You call touches against yourself, {name}, losing or not. That's the most honourable thing in sport.
lines.g_love_quiet: Silent, you're still good company, {name}. Restful, after all the shouting in my life.
lines.g_love_fierce: Once you commit to an attack, {name}, you never pull it. Bello, I respect that.
lines.g_love_warm: Sitting with you feels like a bar in the Spanish Quarter at midnight, {name}, everybody friends.
g_loved: Ah, stop, bello, my head will get even bigger, and it's already a problem.
Grazie, really, and now fix your stance, it's terrible.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You lunge at whatever's soft in people, {name}. Leave that for the enemy, please.
lines.g_hate_kind: You keep offering to help me up, {name}. I'm a fencer, I fall gracefully, let me.
lines.g_hate_funny: Not now, {name}, the bout isn't over. Jokes after the last touch.
lines.g_hate_brave: You charge without a guard, {name}, and call it brave. On a piste that's called losing.
lines.g_hate_steady: The opening closes while you think, {name}. Timing, uaglio, timing.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain my own sport to me, {name}. Twenty six years, and you've held a sword for a week.
lines.g_hate_honest: Every harsh word you think comes straight out, {name}, no parry. Some things need a feint first.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You sulk silently and wait for me to guess, {name}. I read feet, not moods.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Every little thing is a duel with you, {name}. The dinner is not your opponent.
lines.g_hate_warm: You chatter through my warm up, {name}, every morning. Ten minutes of silence, please, for an old competitor.
lines.g_respect: No love between us, {name}, and that's fine, not everyone salutes the same way. But your footwork today was clean, and I'll say so.
lines.g_call_out: Mi dispiace, {name}, but that touch was against you. You lunged early, and we all paid for your timing.
lines.g_stung: Fair, a hit, I felt it. I'll practise alone for a while.
lines.g_concede: Touche, {name}, you had it and I didn't. Fourth place taught me how to lose, at least.
lines.g_nod: Grazie, {name}, a clean touch. No applause needed.
lines.g_callback_save: You parried that blow for me, {name}, when I'd overextended. I don't forget a parry like that.
lines.g_callback_clutch: The two of us on our feet at the end of that bout, everybody else down, both of us gasping. Best final I never fenced.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you called me a show off, I sulked until dinner. Then I fenced plainly, and won faster.
lines.g_former_rivals: First impression, {name}, I thought you had no footwork and no respect. I was wrong about the respect.
lines.g_changed: I used to fight only to win, ragazzi, every time. Lately I fight to keep you lot standing, and it feels better.
g_unguarded: Between us, then. I'm the best I've ever been, and some nights that frightens me more than losing ever did.
Just you, so I'll say it. Fourth place, twice. I'd have given anything to be first, and I think I did.
lines.g_clipped: As you like, uaglio. I'll be on the piste.
lines.g_noticed_open: Bello, that story had footwork, a clean line all the way. Again, please, I'm watching.
arg_ask: {player}, be the referee, please. I've made my attack, they've made a bad one, call the touch.
Jamme, {player}, decide this one. Both attacks, one point, you award it.
lines.arg_backed_me: Grazie, {player}, the point to me. I'll try to celebrate quietly.
lines.arg_backed_them: Va bene, your call, and I'll respect the referee. Still my touch, but I'll respect it.
lines.arg_stayed_out: No call from the referee, eh? Very diplomatic, uaglio.
lines.arg_always_their_side: The points all fall to them, {player}. Even in Naples the referees were fairer, and they were bribed.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody calls it, so I will. My point, and we fence on.
lines.arg_reject: That way I won't fence, {player}, sorry. Some rules I keep.
lines.arg_grumble: Va bene, it's dropped, mostly, because I'm Neapolitan.
lines.arg_settled: A shared touch, then, both lights at once. Fair enough, salute.
lines.seen_listens: Bello, {player}, slow talkers get to the end of their sentence with you. A good coach does that, and you do it.
lines.seen_truth: No feints with you, {player}, ever. The score you tell people is the true one, and I respect that.
lines.seen_jokes: On the bad days the whole squad laughs because of you, {player}. Every salle needs one of those.
lines.seen_stays_out: Clever, {player}, staying off the piste when the others fight. A good tactician.
lines.seen_biased: x Even a fourth place man notices that.
lines.seen_harsh: Gently, {player}, you can be harsh. I was, with myself, and it cost me two finals.
lines.seed_right: Your words after we lost so badly, {player}, went onto the piste with me. It worked, a clean touch, and I wanted you to know.
lines.seed_remember: What you told me the night we lost, {player}, is still in my head, like a coach's voice before a bout.
lines.seed_wrong: Your way on the piste, {player}, lost me the touch. A report, no hard feelings.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: A word, {player}, quietly. That one nearly had me, and for once my hands weren't steady after.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody down, the whole team, me included. Let's watch it back, slowly, like a video of a bad bout, and nobody blamed.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: Showing off, {player}, while {name} fell. One flashy attack too many, and they paid.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Every one of us walking, nothing lost, a perfect bout. Like a gold medal, {player}, the one I never got.
lines.talk_development: Honest question, {player}, fencer to friend. Am I different? I let somebody else take the glory touch today.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: Frustrated, {player}, I coach like my old coach, who was a monster, and {name} has caught it.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} actually fond of me, {player}, or just impressed by the sword?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me mad, {player}, every bout. But in a real fight, I'd want them at my back.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: Watch {name}'s feet, {player}, they're all wrong today. Something's on their mind.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: Between fencers, {player}: the best blade goes to {name}, bout after bout. Explain it, if there's an explanation.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: Plainly, uaglio, {name} and I don't work as a pair. Pretending is like fencing with the button off.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep attacking with no retreat, {player}. On a piste you always know where the back line is.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: I read {name} badly, {player}, start to end. They had the better timing, and I want that said.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Calmly, {player}, and honestly. The big bouts go on without me. Is it my blade, or the voice?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit is with {name}, and I learned it on my own. A word first, {player}, and it was theirs.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Grazie, {player}, that helps. Espresso, if I can find one.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll recover, I always do. Give it a night.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help, I'm afraid. I'll practise alone.
lines.talk_lands_development: So it shows, then. Bello, then it's real.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not. A fencer can't see his own feet.
lines.talk_stings_development: Wrong call on that bout, {player}, I think.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, {name} and I will speak, one to one, no blades.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, who knows. People don't salute before they lunge.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please, and nothing to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: A fair touch, I accept it. It stings, but it's clean.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Message received, uaglio, and tonight it gets considered.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's the score, then, va bene.
lines.talk_door_closed: That bout's over for tonight, ragazzi, and the fire is calling.
lines.arc_cracks: I lost a sparring bout today, {player}, to the kid I've been training, fairly. And I laughed. I didn't know I could.
lines.arc_turn: I took the voice's help because I was tired of fourth, {player}. I think I've been fourth at something else all along.
lines.arc_become: I know what's mine now, ragazzi, and what isn't. I'm not the best blade here, but every touch I make is my own.
lines.arc_failed: I still lean on it, {player}, every fight. I tell myself next time I'll fence alone, and I never do.
lines.alt_turn: It offered me more last night, {player}, and the yes was out before I'd thought. I'm frightened, so you should know.
lines.alt_become: I'm the best there is now, {player}. I don't know whose sword it is any more, and I've stopped asking.
lines.g_roast_after: Still the worst footwork I've ever coached, ragazzi, and I'd fence beside every one of you.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, feet first, a hand for the one beside you. We lose as a team, we fence again as a team.
lines.g_toast_after: To my team, who taught a fourth place man what winning actually is. Salute to all of you, ragazzi.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my salle now, ragazzi, all of you. My students, my team, my people.
g_quiet_line_after: Lost a bout today and slept well anyway. Twenty six years and that never happened.
The kid I'm training beat me clean today. Best thing that's happened to me here.
g_loved_after: Grazie, and I believe it, first time, which is new for a man like me.
Bello, I'll keep that, quietly, for once.

history.open: You're watching my feet, {player}, good, that's where the fight is. Sabre for Naples since I was eight. Fourth at the Olympic trials, twice. Fourth is the worst place there is.

options.text: Why is fourth worse than fifth?
options.reply: Because fifth can tell himself he was never close. Fourth was one touch from a medal, twice. You live in that touch, uaglio.

options.text: Fourth in the country is still amazing.
options.reply: Bello, kind of you, and also completely wrong. But I like you for saying it.
Jamme, now, right here. Feet apart, knees bent, and stop watching my blade. Good, you're already better than most.

history.open: The Scarlets asked me to join them, {player}, twice. They wanted my blade for their crusade. I've seen what they do in those villages, and I told them where to put their crusade.

options.reply: Grazie, uaglio, I agree. A sword should have principles, even if the man holding it is vain. I'm both, apparently.

options.text: Why do you live by their grounds, then?
options.reply: To watch them drill, every morning. Know your enemy's footwork, uaglio. One day it'll matter.

history.open: My father died when I was twelve, {player}. He took me to my first salle, and he never saw me fence a real bout. My mother came to every one after, and shouted at every referee in Campania.

options.reply: Maybe, maybe not. He'd say watch your feet. He always said that, it's where I got it.
Rosaria, the loudest woman in Naples, and the best ragu. She'd have shouted the Olympic referee into giving me bronze.

friend.open: A voice in the dark offered me more, {player}, and I took it. Now I'm the best I've ever been. The price is that I'll never know if it's really me holding the sword. That's the worst part, worse than fourth.

options.reply: Without it, you mean. Fence alone and see. Yes, maybe, one day. I'm frightened of the answer.
Is it really me? I hope so. Thank you for saying it like you mean it.

sworn.open: In fencing you salute your opponent and the referee, {player}, before every bout. I salute you, every day, for the rest of it. That's the highest honour I know.

options.reply: Bello, then we're bound, en garde, together. No more fourth place for either of us.
Ha, forever, uaglio, every morning at dawn. You'll regret it by Tuesday.

reconciled.open: {name} and I crossed blades and settled it, a clean salute at the end. Peace in the salle, and I wanted you to know.

options.reply: Grazie, it's like the end of a good bout, everything lighter.
A double touch, both lights. The fairest ending there is.
